query: We just spent 20 minutes figuring out the right flags to migrate our Prisma schema safely in staging. Can you turn that workflow into a reusable skill so the agent remembers it next time?

I want a skill that bundles a small Node script for optimizing SVG icons. Set it up with the script under scripts/ and explain when to use it.
Help me design an agent skill for configuring Vitest workspaces, including the frontmatter and a few starter eval cases.

can you make a skill out of the Tailwind v4 migration steps we just went through?
